report_name: Europol Dismantles KillSec Ransomware; Teenager Suspected Leader

threat_actors.name: KillSec
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group known for double-extortion tactics, operating a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. The group is linked to approximately 1,000 attacks worldwide and was dismantled by an international law enforcement operation in September 2026. A 16-year-old is suspected of being the main operator.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: KillSec encrypted victim's data as a primary component of their ransomware attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Extortion
attack_patterns.description: KillSec used double-extortion tactics, threatening to publish exfiltrated data on their leak site if the ransom was not paid.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: KillSec ransomware likely deletes volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin to prevent system recovery.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: KillSec exfiltrated victim data to their own infrastructure to be used for double-extortion threats.

malware.name: KillSec Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the KillSec group for encrypting victim data and facilitating extortion.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by KillSec ransomware to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

campaigns.name: Operation KillSwitch
campaigns.description: An international law enforcement operation led by German authorities and coordinated by Europol to dismantle the infrastructure of the KillSec ransomware group in September 2026.

identities.name: Europol
identities.description: Coordinated the international law enforcement operation, Operation KillSwitch, that dismantled the KillSec ransomware group.

identities.name: German authorities
identities.description: Led Operation KillSwitch, the takedown of the KillSec ransomware group.

infrastructure.name: KillSec Darknet Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A Tor-based website used by KillSec to publish stolen data from victims as part of their double-extortion strategy. It was seized during Operation KillSwitch.

infrastructure.name: KillSec C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Command and control servers used by KillSec ransomware to communicate with operators, receive commands, and manage encryption keys. This infrastructure was seized during Operation KillSwitch.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9c5b8f8a-1b7e-4b1e-8f0a-9c8d7e6f5a4b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.europol.europa.eu/media-press/newsroom/news/teenager-suspected-of-leading-killsec-ransomware-group-law-enforcement-seizes-servers-and-leak-site
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-01
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: KillSec Ransom Note Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: KillSec Ransom Note Creation
id: 3d2e1c0b-a9b8-4c7d-6e5f-4a3b2c1d0e9f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file named RANSOM_NOTE.txt, a common indicator of a ransomware infection.
references:
  - https://www.europol.europa.eu/media-press/newsroom/news/teenager-suspected-of-leading-killsec-ransomware-group-law-enforcement-seizes-servers-and-leak-site
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-01
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\RANSOM_NOTE.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a file named RANSOM_NOTE.txt, a common indicator of a ransomware infection.
